body_markdown:
Imagine waking up in the morning to see money added to your wallet, without lifting a finger. Sounds like a dream, right? Well, it’s not. With BuyPower **Virtual Account** feature, merchants can now earn **passive income** by enabling their customers to buy electricity on their own using a dedicated account linked to their business.


Whether you're a business owner, a digital entrepreneur, or a side hustler looking for extra income, this blog post will show you how to **set up a BuyPower MFB Virtual Account** and start earning commissions automatically.


## **What is a Virtual Account?**


A **BuyPower Virtual Account** is a unique NUBAN bank account linked to a specific electricity meter. When your customers transfer money into this account to pay for electricity, their token is delivered automatically via SMS, and **you earn a commission** for every successful transaction.


You don’t need to be online, make a call, or type anything. Just set it up once and start **making money in your sleep** .


**Why Merchants Love It**


**** Imagine waking up in the morning to see money added to your wallet, without lifting a finger. Sounds like a dream, right? Well, it’s not. With BuyPower’s **Virtual Account** feature, merchants can now earn **passive income** by enabling their customers to buy electricity on their own using a dedicated account linked to their business.

## **Why Merchants Love It**


- **Passive Income** : Customers pay directly. You earn automatically.
- **No Manual Work** : No more copy-pasting meter numbers or generating tokens yourself.
- **Instant Token Delivery** : Tokens are sent to customers via SMS instantly.
- **Transparent Earnings** : Your commissions are credited straight to your wallet.


**How to Create Your Virtual Account (Step-by-Step)**


**Step 1: Log in to your BuyPower Merchant Dashboard**
Download the BuyPower Merchant App on the[Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ng.buypower.merchant&hl=en) or[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/eg/app/buypower-merchant/id6502284876) , or visit[https://buypower.ng/merchant](https://buypower.ng/merchant) and sign in using your merchant account credentials.


**Step 2: Click on the “Virtual Account” Tab**
You'll find this on your merchant dashboard menu.


**Step 3: Enter Required Information**
You’ll need to provide the following:


- Meter Number (of the customer or business location)
- Phone Number (where tokens should be sent)
- DISCO (Distribution Company, e.g., AEDC, PHEDC, etc.)


**Step 4: Submit to Generate Account Details**
Once completed, a unique **BuyPower MFB Virtual Account** will be generated for that meter.


**Step 5: Share the Virtual Account with Customers**
Give this account number to your customers. When they transfer money to it, they’ll get their electricity token instantly, and you get your **commission** right after the transaction is completed.


## **How You Make Money**


Every time a customer makes a payment into your virtual account, **BuyPower processes the transaction** , sends the token to the customer, and **credits your wallet with your commission** .


Your earnings depend on the **volume of purchases** , so the more customers use your virtual account, the more you earn, without being actively involved.


## **Tips to Maximize Your Earnings**


1. **Promote your virtual account on WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook**
Let people know they can buy light from you *24/7,* even when you're offline.
2. **Create multiple virtual accounts for different meters**
Target family, friends, and frequent customers who rely on you for tokens.
3. **Bundle it with your existing business**
Run a salon, barbershop, or POS center? Offer customers electricity tokens along with their other purchases.


## **Ready to Start Earning?**


Creating a virtual account on BuyPower is **free** , fast, and incredibly rewarding. It's your chance to **turn every token purchase into passive profit** .


Log in to your merchant dashboard, create your virtual account, and start earning today!
